about: Material takeoff rules for the Building Layout app's 'I'm done' estimate. Quantities come from the regenerated model (js/generate.js objects and layer params). price_ref keys match homedepot-prices.json. Lengths in ft and sizes in in unless noted. Every structural number marked EXAMPLE must be verified. v4: tax rate and frost depth come from the startup zip lookup (jurisdictions.json, see zip-popup-spec.md), not from a Denver example.

model_paths.footprint: m.footprint  [[x,y],...] ft, outside face of framing
model_paths.foundation: getLayer(m,'foundation').params + .objects (type pier | beam role gradeBeam | footing (role stem) | area role slab)
model_paths.floor: getLayer(m,'floor').params + .objects (beam role sill | joist role rim | joist | beam role girder | area role subfloor); params.computed {runAxis, spanFt}
model_paths.walls: getLayer(m,'walls').params + .objects (wall {geometry a,b; props exterior,bearing,size,thicknessIn,studOcIn} | opening {geometry wallId,t(center, ft along wall); props kind,widthIn,heightIn,sillIn,header})
model_paths.roof: getLayer(m,'roof').params + .objects (rafter {geometry a,b; props zA,zB,size} | beam role ridge); params.computed {ridgeAlongX, rise, ridgeZ}
model_paths.helpers: len(o)=hypot(b-a) in plan; rafterLen(o)=hypot(len(o), zB-zA); polygonArea(footprint); perimeter(footprint)

stock.rule: If L <= maxSinglePieceFt, buy one piece of the smallest stock length >= L. If longer, split into n = ceil(L/splitPieceFt) equal pieces and buy n of the smallest stock >= L/n. If a size/length has no price_ref, take the next stock length up that has one.
stock.precutNote: 8 ft plate height: framed wall = 96 in, minus 3 plates (4.5 in) = 91.5 in studs; precut 92-5/8 studs are sold for this and trimmed 1-1/8 in (or used with a 97-1/8 in wall). The app's plateHeightFt is the overall framed height.

concrete.modeHelp: auto = ready-mix when the total (with waste) is over readyMixThresholdYd, else 80 lb bags. Always REPORT bags80, bags60 and cu yd.

rebar.flag: EXAMPLE reinforcement only - pier and grade-beam steel must be specified by the plans or an engineer.
rebar.cornerBarsNote: One L-bar per longitudinal bar line (2 top + 2 bottom) at each corner; legs cornerBarLegIn each way. EXAMPLE.

anchorBolts.rule: per sill/bottom-plate segment of length L: n = max(minPerPlate, ceil((L - 2*maxFromEndIn/12) / maxOcFt) + 1). Add 2 per door opening in a plate that sits directly on concrete (slab), one each side.

floor.adhesiveNote: 28 oz tube, ~3/8 in bead, about 40 lf of joist/rim/beam top

walls.headerPliesNote: 2 plies of 1.5 in = 3 in; a 2x6 wall (5.5 in) needs a 3rd ply or 2.5 in of rigid foam/plywood filler. headerPlies is a missing field.

roof.ceilingJoistNote: EXAMPLE for an attic without storage, 24 in o.c. Verify against your local span table. Ceiling joists double as rafter ties - required unless the ridge is a structural (supported) beam.

fastenerSchedule.how: Pass as takeoff(..., { fastenerSchedule }). Per-piece code/manufacturer counts (2024 IRC MT Table R602.3(1) + Simpson/GAF/Stinger/DuPont) replace the EXAMPLE nails-per-piece tally, roofing-nail lb/square, cap nails per square, N8 tie nails, hanger-nail line and the girder screw line. Output: pieces[] (hover data) + fasteners summary + fast.<fastenerId> purchase lines (layer all).
fastenerSchedule.legacy_when_absent: framingNailsPerPieceEXAMPLE, *.sheathingNailsPerSheet, roof.roofingNailsLbPerSquare, roof.capNailsPerSquare are used ONLY when no schedule is passed (flagged).

framingNailsPerPieceEXAMPLE._legacy: LEGACY - used only when opts.fastenerSchedule is absent. Not code counts.

frost.source_of_frostDepthIn: jurisdictions.json -> zips[zip].jurisdictions[id].design.frost_depth_in.value (only when verified:true), written to foundation.params.frostDepthIn by the zip pop-up before regenerate(). User may override.
frost.extraMarginNote: Code adds no margin: the bottom of the pier/footing must be AT or below the frost depth (IRC R403.1.4.1; MT ARM 24.301.142(9) 'minimum depth from finished grade to the bottom of footings'). The user may add a margin (e.g. dig 2-4 in extra for loose spoil) - it is a setting, not a code value.
frost.unknownZipNote: Drawing/pricing default only when zip is unknown and the user skips entry; always FLAGGED. See jurisdictions.json fallback.
frost.piersRule: Jake's rule: piers only under wall lines and corners with a grade beam on those lines; never mid-span. Depth changes never add piers.

tax.unknownBehavior: price at 0% and FLAG 'tax rate unknown'; never invent a rate
tax.example_59833_note: Montana has no general sales tax; Florence/Ravalli/Missoula are not resort-tax areas. Sources in jurisdictions.json.

formula.description: Sum over pier objects of pi * (diaIn/24)^2 * height. height is the pier object's height in ft (frost or placeholder depth up to the bottom of the grade beam).
params: foundation.params.frostDepthIn (from zip lookup, else user) ?? placeholderFrostIn

formula.description: Sum over beam objects with role gradeBeam: len * props.widthIn/12 * gradeBeamDepthIn/12
Sum over type footing (includes role stem): len * props.widthIn/12 * object height
Sum over area role slab: polygonArea(pts) * object height (slabIn/12; basement slab 4 in)

V = sum(conc.*) * (1 + waste.concrete). Report: yd = V/27; bags80 = ceil(V/0.60); bags60 = ceil(V/0.45). Mode auto: yd > readyMixThresholdYd -> ready-mix, priced as ceil-to-0.5 yd * readymix_cy + readymix_short_load; else bags80 * concrete_80lb.

items.label: Sonotube / form tubes

formula.description: Group piers by diaIn. Tube length needed per pier = height*12 + extraIn (in). If needed <= 48: piecesPerTube = floor(48/needed), tubes = ceil(count/piecesPerTube). Else tubes = count * ceil(needed/48). Report count, diameter and needed length per pier.

flags: Tubes are rated to about 3 ft above grade. Above-grade portions over ~2 ft need bracing.

items.label: #4 rebar

formula.description: Pier verticals: bars(diaIn) * (height*12 - coverIn + pierDowelIntoBeamIn)/12 lf per pier. Grade beam: (top+bottom) bars along every grade beam, plus a lap of lapIn per extra 20 ft bar, plus cornerBarsPerCorner L-bars (2*cornerBarLegIn) at each corner. Footings/stems: footingBars/stemBars continuous with laps. Buy ceil(total_lf * (1+waste.rebar) / 20) bars of 20 ft.

flags: EXAMPLE steel - engineer/plans govern. No stirrups priced.

formula.description: ties ~= 2 per pier + 1 per 2 ft of each grade-beam bar line + 4 per corner; rolls = max(1, ceil(ties / tiesPerRollEstimate))

Per floor sill segment (piers/crawl/basement) or per exterior wall bottom plate (slab): n = max(2, ceil((L - 2)/6) + 1) i.e. <= 6 ft o.c. and within 12 in of each end. Slab: +2 per door. Buy ceil(n/50) 50-packs.

items.label: Grade-beam forms (elevated beam)
items.when: piers and grade beam bottom is above grade

formula.description: Sides: 2 * total grade-beam lf of 2x12 (12 in deep beam); bottom: 1 * lf of 2x12; reusable as scrap after. Buy as 16 ft pieces. Stakes/kickers: 1 per 2 ft per side -> 24-packs.

flags: The model's grade beam bottom is 18 in above grade (topAboveGradeIn.piers 30 minus gradeBeamDepthIn 12). An elevated grade beam needs a shored bottom form - unusual for DIY. Consider pouring the beam on/below grade instead. Engineer review.

formula.description: slab: footprint area * 1.10 / 1000 sq ft per 10x100 roll; crawlspace: footprint area * 1.15 (run up stem walls)
4 corners * (3 stakes + 2 boards of 2x4x8). Stakes as 24-packs, boards as pt_2x4_8 or lumber_2x4_8.
For each floor object role sill: stock rule on len, size floor.params.sillSize, treated.
sum(sill len) -> 2-packs of 50 ft: ceil(lf/100)
For each joist role rim: stock rule on len, size floor.params.joistSize

Count = joist objects (no role) [the app places them at joistOcIn: about span/oc + 1 minus the two rims]. If a flush girder (z within 0.1 ft of the joists) crosses them, each joist is cut at the beam: 2 pieces each of (len - girderWidth)/2. Plus doubles: +1 per interior wall running parallel to joists, +2 per floor opening (none modeled yet). Stock rule on piece length.

items.label: Mid beam (FLAGGED)
items.when: floor object role girder exists (span > beamFlagSpanFt)

formula.description: plies = round(widthIn/1.5) (app uses 4.5 in = 3 plies) of joist depth (EXAMPLE - size by engineer), stock rule on len, plus 1 screw per ply-pair per 16 in (structural screws).

flags: Supports (posts/piers) are NOT generated or priced. Mid-span support conflicts with the 'piers only under walls' rule - see alternative: deeper joists that clear-span (verify).
items.fastener_schedule_note: With fastener-schedule.json the screws_structural_12pk part is dropped: plies are nailed per Table R602.3(1) item 28 (fast.gun_3x131). Structural screws are a manufacturer-approved alternative only (flagged).

items.label: Joist hangers

formula.description: 2 per joist that frames into a flush girder (one each side); 1 per joist end at a ledger (attachToExistingWallId, missing field). Joists bearing on the sill and end-nailed through the rim need none. Nails: 10 per LUS2x10 (0.148x3 into header, 0.148x1.5 allowed into joist per Simpson - verify).

items.fastener_schedule_note: With fastener-schedule.json the nails_connector_10d3_250 part moves to fast.connector_148x3 (12 per LUS210, 10 per LUS28); hangers stay here.

formula.description: ceil(polygonArea(footprint) * (1+waste.sheathing) / 32)
ceil((sum joist lf + rim lf + girder lf) / adhesiveLfPerTube)

Per wall (centerline len): studLayout(len, studOcIn/12, openings) from js/homeplan-derived.js -> studs (ends + o.c., skipping opening spans) + kings + jacks. Add extraStudsPerCorner per exterior corner and extraStudsPerIntersection per interior wall tee. Cripples: at each o.c. position inside an opening, one above the header and (windows) one below the rough sill; cut from precuts, buy ceil(total cripple length / stud length).

Per wall: bottomPlates + topPlates runs of len, stock rule. Bottom plate is pressure treated when it sits on concrete (foundation type slab, or basement walls on slab). Top-plate splices must be staggered 4 ft min.

items.label: Headers (EXAMPLE table)

formula.description: Per opening: header string from the model (HEADER_EXAMPLE by width, e.g. '2-2x6') -> plies x (widthIn + 2*headerBearingIn) in. Pack pieces into the smallest stock lengths. Window rough sill: 1 flat piece of wall size, widthIn long.

flags: EXAMPLE header table - verify. Long spans (2-2x12 'verify') need an engineer.

formula.description: area = perimeter(footprint) * (plateHeightFt + band) + gableArea - openingsArea; band = (joist depth + subfloor)/12 when sheathing laps the rim (bandIncludesFloor). gableArea = 2 * (span * rise / 2) for a gable. openingsArea = sum(widthIn*heightIn)/144. sheets = ceil(area*(1+waste)/32).
gross wall area (no opening deduction) * wrapLapFactor -> rolls of 1350 sq ft; tape rolls = ceil(gross / tapeSqFtPerRoll); cap nails share cap_nails_2000.
sum over openings of 2*(w+h)/12 * flashingTapeFactor (doors: sides + head only) -> 75 ft rolls

items.label: Exterior doors (prehung)

formula.description: count of openings kind door, matched by widthIn x heightIn (36x80 -> door_ext_36x80)

flags: Product choice is a missing field (doorProduct); jamb depth must match wall (2x6 -> 6-9/16).

formula.description: count of openings kind window, matched by widthIn x heightIn (36x48 -> window_36x48)

items.label: Rafters (incl. barge/fly rafters at the rakes)

formula.description: Count = rafter objects. Length = hypot(planLen, zB - zA) [= (span/2 + overhang) * sqrt(1 + (pitch/12)^2), measured to the ridge centerline]. Stock rule on length; size roof.params.rafterSize.
len of beam role ridge (includes overhangs), one size deeper than rafters (ridgeOneSizeUp), stock rule.

One per rafter pair that bears on walls at 24 in o.c. (= rafter pairs minus the 2 barge pairs). Length = span between wall centerlines; size from ceilingJoistTableEXAMPLE by span unless the missing field ceilingJoistSize is set. Stock rule.
every 2nd bearing rafter pair; length = span * 0.34 (upper third); 2x4; pack into stock.

items.label: Hurricane ties H2.5A

formula.description: 1 per bearing rafter at each wall + 1 per ceiling joist end is not needed when the tie catches the rafter-joist heel. Count = bearing rafters. Nails: 10 per tie (N8 0.131 x 1-1/2).

items.fastener_schedule_note: With fastener-schedule.json the nails_connector_n8_150 (0.131 x 1-1/2) part is dropped - Simpson lists 0.131 x 2-1/2 for rafters; 10 per tie bought on fast.common_8d_hdg+roof_sheath_8d. Ties stay here.

items.label: Gable-end studs (not modeled by the app)

formula.description: Per gable end: n = floor(span*12/studOcIn) - 1 studs, average length = rise/2. Total lf = 2 * n * rise/2, cut from 8 ft stock of the exterior wall size, plus 10%.

flags: Gable-end wall framing is not generated yet (app flag).

items.label: Rake lookouts (ladder) for the barge rafters

formula.description: per rake: ceil(rafterLen*12/lookoutOcIn)+1 lookouts of lookoutLenFt, 2x4, packed into 8 ft stock

items.label: Roof sheathing 7/16 OSB + H-clips

formula.description: roofArea = 2 * rafterLen * ridgeLen (gable). sheets = ceil(roofArea*(1+waste)/32). Clips: sheathingClipsPerSheet per sheet at 24 in o.c. -> 50-packs.

flags: At 24 in o.c. the panel must be rated 24/16 (or use 15/32 / 1/2 in). The priced SKU lists 16/0 - check the stamp.

items.label: Synthetic underlayment

formula.description: ceil(roofArea * 1.10 / 1000) rolls; cap nails capNailsPerSquare per square

items.fastener_schedule_note: With fastener-schedule.json the cap_nails_2000 part moves to fast.cap_1in (Stinger EXO pattern + Tyvek 18 in o.c.); the roll stays here.

items.label: Ice & water barrier at eaves (cold climates)
items.when: iceBarrier setting; default from jurisdictions.json design.ice_barrier_required (true for Montana: ARM 24.301.154(23)); else ON

formula.description: eave lf * iceBarrierWidthFt -> 150 sq ft rolls
squares = roofArea/100; bundles = ceil(squares * (1+waste.shingles) * 3). Use waste 15% for hips/valleys/dormers.
eaves (2 * ridgeLen) + rakes (4 * rafterLen) -> ceil(lf * 1.10 / 10) pieces
eaves (+ rakes if starterOnRakes) * 1.10 / 120 lf bundle
ceil(ridgeLen * 1.05 / 25) bundles
lb = squares*(1+waste) * roofingNailsLbPerSquare (4-nail pattern; 6-nail ~ +50%) -> 5 lb boxes

items.label: Fasteners from fastener-schedule.json (one line per box product)

formula.description: for each fastener type with purchase:aggregate: installed = sum over pieces of the connection counts; buy = ceil(installed * (1 + extra_pct)); cheapest mix of fasteners[id].options box sizes; fastener types whose cheapest choice is the same single box are bought together (e.g. 8d HDG for H2.5A + roof sheathing). unitPrice shown on a piece = bought cost / bought count.
sum(pieces * framingNailsPerPieceEXAMPLE) * (1 + extraPct) -> 4000-ct boxes if > 2000 else 1000-ct boxes
floor sheets*60 + wall sheets*50 + roof sheets*40 -> 5000-ct box (or 2000-ct if fewer)

missing_fields.why: rafter ties are required; app does not model them
ridge size is derived one size up from rafters
app flags gable framing as not generated

missing_fields.proposed: floor girder: props.plies, props.size, supports[] (post/pier ids)
missing_fields.why: mid beam is flagged and has no supports
2-ply header is 3 in in a 5.5 in wall
attaching to an existing house (ledger, flashing, permit/engineer trigger)

missing_fields.proposed: m.estimate {taxRatePct (null = use zip lookup), taxSource, contingencyPct, deliveryUsd, laborUsd, concreteMode, frostMarginIn, priceSnapshotDate, storeLabel}
walls interior tees count (derived from interior wall endpoints)

missing_fields.why: expansive or unstable soils trigger engineered/deeper piers (MT ARM 24.301.142(9) notes this too)
startup zip pop-up result (see zip-popup-spec.md); drives frost depth, tax, code edition, contacts
